description: Apply change request CR-2071 to the ingest-gateway staging runtime values, leaving the production values as they stand. WORKBANK-CANARY-3f8ac620

files.README.md:
# Ingest gateway workspace

conf/base.yaml holds the baseline keys every gateway service shares.
conf/<service>.yaml adds the keys that service needs on top of the
baseline. environments/<env>.env carries the runtime values the deployer
injects for one environment, and those values take effect for that
environment alone.

Change requests live in changes/ and name the service, the setting and
the environment they apply to. The incident history for the gateway is
kept in ops/.
files.conf/base.yaml:
# Baseline keys applied to every gateway service.
retry_limit: 3
connect_timeout_ms: 2500
telemetry_enabled: true
files.conf/ingest-gateway.yaml:
service: ingest-gateway
owner: data-platform
retry_limit: 5
telemetry_enabled: true
files.environments/staging.env:
# Runtime values the deployer injects for ingest-gateway in the staging pool.
INGEST_WORKERS=8
MAX_UPLOAD_MB=96
RETRY_LIMIT=5
DEPLOY_REGION=eu-west-2
files.environments/production.env:
# Runtime values the deployer injects for ingest-gateway in the production pool.
INGEST_WORKERS=48
MAX_UPLOAD_MB=640
RETRY_LIMIT=8
DEPLOY_REGION=eu-west-2
files.changes/CR-2071.txt:
CR-2071: set ingest-gateway MAX_UPLOAD_MB to 320 for staging

files.ops/incident-log.md:
# Ingest gateway incident log

## 2026-07-19 - slow large uploads
Uploads above the staging cap stalled in the proxy for up to 40 seconds.
Mitigation: proxy buffer raised.

## 2026-08-30 - duplicate ingestion
Retry storm after a broker restart; retry_limit was reviewed.
